literal: Even if they do things that bring ruin, they do not cut off their affection—those of friendship that came in the path of love.
translation: Even if they do things that cause ruin or pain, those whose friendship has come down through long-standing affection will never diminish in their love.
modern: அன்பின் வழியில் வந்த நீண்ட கால நட்பை உடையவர்கள், தமக்கு அழிவைத் தரும் செயல்களைச் செய்தாலும், அவர்கள் தம் அன்பைக் குறைத்துக் கொள்ள மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the strength of long-standing, traditional friendship. Those who share a deep-rooted friendship based on mutual affection will not abandon their love even if their friends commit acts that cause them ruin or distress. The key words 'அழிவந்த' (bringing ruin or pain) and 'அன்பறார்' (not cutting off love) emphasize that true, old friendship is resilient enough to withstand even severe mistakes or harmful actions.
